mapper.sql: select a.alert_id, a.alert_type, a.ref_id, a.alert_level, a.title, a.content, a.status, a.del_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark, bs.project_id, bs.category, p.project_no, p.project_name from alert a join budget_split bs on a.ref_id = bs.split_id join project p on bs.project_id = p.project_id left join sys_dept d on p.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user u on p.leader_id = u.user_id
mapper.select: select count(*) from alert where alert_type = 'BUDGET' and ref_id = #{refId} and del_flag = '0' and status in ('UNREAD', 'READ')
mapper.sql: select a.alert_id, a.alert_type, a.ref_id, a.ref_type, a.alert_level, a.title, a.content, a.status, a.biz_key, a.round, a.first_time, a.last_time, a.del_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark, case a.ref_type when 'CONTRACT' then cn.node_name when 'PROJECT' then p_pj.project_name when 'DOCUMENT' then pd.file_name else bs.category end as ref_name, coalesce(p_cn.project_id, p_pj.project_id, p_pd.project_id, p_bs.project_id) as project_id, coalesce(p_cn.project_no, p_pj.project_no, p_pd.project_no, p_bs.project_no) as project_no, coalesce(p_cn.project_name, p_pj.project_name, p_pd.project_name, p_bs.project_name) as project_name, coalesce(p_cn.leader_id, p_pj.leader_id, p_pd.leader_id, p_bs.leader_id) as leader_id from alert a left join contract_node cn on a.ref_type = 'CONTRACT' and a.ref_id = cn.node_id and cn.del_flag = '0' left join contract c on cn.contract_id = c.contract_id and c.del_flag = '0' left join project p_cn on c.project_id = p_cn.project_id and p_cn.del_flag = '0' left join project p_pj on a.ref_type = 'PROJECT' and a.ref_id = p_pj.project_id and p_pj.del_flag = '0' left join project_document pd on a.ref_type = 'DOCUMENT' and a.ref_id = pd.doc_id and pd.del_flag = '0' left join project p_pd on pd.project_id = p_pd.project_id and p_pd.del_flag = '0' left join budget_split bs on a.ref_type is null and a.alert_type = 'BUDGET' and a.ref_id = bs.split_id and bs.del_flag = '0' left join project p_bs on bs.project_id = p_bs.project_id and p_bs.del_flag = '0' left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = coalesce(p_cn.dept_id, p_pj.dept_id, p_pd.dept_id, p_bs.dept_id) left join sys_user u on u.user_id = coalesce(p_cn.leader_id, p_pj.leader_id, p_pd.leader_id, p_bs.leader_id)
mapper.select: select alert_id, alert_type, ref_id, ref_type, alert_level, title, content, status, biz_key, round, first_time, last_time, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from alert where biz_key = #{bizKey} and status = 'OPEN' and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select coalesce(max(round), 0) from alert where biz_key = #{bizKey} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update alert set last_time = #{lastTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate where alert_id = #{alertId} and del_flag = '0'

update alert set status = 'RESOLVED', remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate where alert_id = #{alertId} and status in ('OPEN', 'UNREAD', 'READ', 'HANDLED') and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select cn.node_id as refId, 'CONTRACT' as refType, p.project_id as projectId, p.leader_id as leaderId, cn.node_name as nodeName, c.contract_name as contractName, cn.plan_date as planDate, p.project_no as projectNo, p.project_name as projectName from contract_node cn join contract c on cn.contract_id = c.contract_id and c.del_flag = '0' join project p on c.project_id = p.project_id and p.del_flag = '0' where cn.status = 'PENDING' and cn.del_flag = '0' and cn.plan_date between trunc(sysdate) and trunc(sysdate) + 15

select p.project_id as refId, 'PROJECT' as refType, p.project_id as projectId, p.leader_id as leaderId, p.project_no as projectNo, p.project_name as projectName, p.budget_total as budgetTotal, p.budget_balance as budgetBalance from project p where p.del_flag = '0' and ( p.budget_balance <= 1000 or (p.budget_total > 0 and p.budget_balance / p.budget_total <= 0.05) )

select pd.doc_id as refId, 'DOCUMENT' as refType, pd.project_id as projectId, p.leader_id as leaderId, pd.file_name as fileName, pd.plan_submit_date as planSubmitDate, p.project_no as projectNo, p.project_name as projectName from project_document pd join project p on pd.project_id = p.project_id and p.del_flag = '0' where pd.del_flag = '0' and pd.plan_submit_date < trunc(sysdate) and ( not exists ( select 1 from approval a where a.doc_id = pd.doc_id and a.del_flag = '0' ) or exists ( select 1 from approval a where a.doc_id = pd.doc_id and a.del_flag = '0' and a.status = 'PENDING' ) )
